skills.description: Convert any PDF (image-heavy, formula-heavy, complex-layout, multi-column, slide-deck, or pure-image) into clean, searchable Markdown and JSON. Uses a two-phase pipeline: PyMuPDF extraction + Agnes-2.0-Flash vision model transcription with LaTeX formulas, table parsing, and exhaustive image description. Triggers on: PDF 转换, PDF 转 markdown, 提取PDF内容, convert PDF, PDF OCR, 公式提取, 论文转录.
skills.description_zh: 将含图片/公式/复杂排版的 PDF 转为可搜索 Markdown+JSON。公式→LaTeX，表格→markdown table，图片→文字描述。基于Agnes视觉模型
